caseName: Denver & Rio Grande Railroad v. Da Vella
caseNameFull: Denver & Rio Grande Railroad Company v. Oresta Da Vella, Royal Italian Consul, as Administrator, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Colorado.
attorneys: Mr. Elroy N. Clark and Mr. Wm. C. Prentiss for plaintiff in error.' Mr. W. F. San-born for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237' of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
